ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 85% low-intensity black pixels across the central fluke and 15% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous marbled white-and-black blobs located at the lateral tips of both lobes. Two isolated high-intensity circular focal points are visible in the central-left quadrant of the black surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with an acute angle estimated at 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, with significant pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) at the distal ends.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular high-contrast pixel clusters in the lower-mid region of the left lobe. Dense clusters of small white circular anomalies are visible along the extreme margins of the fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Unordered linear pixel disruptions appearing as horizontal and diagonal light-gray striations on the right lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, near-rectangular notch or indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating significant physical trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Rhythmic zebra-like marbling on the fluke tips, particularly on the right lobe, creating a unique high-contrast visual fingerprint.
